regulatoryAuthority: Directorate General of Drug Administration (DGDA) & Department of Livestock Services (DLS), Bangladesh

drugs.regulatoryNotice: Colistin is strictly prohibited for food animal production in Bangladesh and internationally by WHO due to extreme human AMR risk (last-resort antibiotic).
drugs.indications: No legal veterinary indication in poultry.

drugs.regulatoryNotice: Critically Important Antimicrobial (CIA). Prohibited for commercial egg-laying flocks. Requires registered veterinary prescription with AST confirmation.
drugs.localEggWithdrawalDays: Not permitted for laying hens producing table eggs
drugs.indications: Severe respiratory complexes (CRD), Colibacillosis under veterinary supervision only.

drugs.regulatoryNotice: Standard poultry antimicrobial. Withholding period must be strictly adhered to before slaughter.
drugs.indications: Fowl cholera, infectious coryza, bacterial enteritis.

drugs.regulatoryNotice: High binding affinity. Not recommended in laying birds.
Respiratory specific. Cardiotoxic if injected; water soluble formulation strictly under vet oversight.
drugs.localEggWithdrawalDays: Not authorized for layers producing eggs for human consumption

drugs.regulatoryNotice: Broad spectrum bactericidal. Susceptible to beta-lactamase resistance.
Non-antibiotic coccidiocide. Acts on all intracellular developmental stages of Eimeria.
drugs.localEggWithdrawalDays: Not for use in replacement pullets within 4 weeks of laying or in active layers
drugs.indications: Clinical and subclinical coccidiosis in broiler and breeder flocks.
